title: EviCraft: Can Minecraft Agents Find What They Cannot See?
abstract: arXiv:2611.32765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In Minecraft, a common testbed for embodied agents, semantic tools such as mineBlock pick targets from the simulator's loaded world state without a visibility test, so a buried ore the agent has never seen is one call away, and scores cannot show whether the agent searched. We formalize the missing requirement as evidence closure: every decision of an agent system, including those inside its tools, may depend on the world only through facts for which the agent holds evidence. EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces closure below the agent and makes the admission rule an experimental variable: a perception-grounded regime (G) admits only what is in line of sight or returned by the agent's own actions, and a loaded-state regime (L) reproduces standard tool stacks, with agents, tools, and worlds held fixed. On Survival, the regime effect exceeds the strongest agent's lead: under G, three mid-sized agents reach the diamond in 32%-4

translated_title: EviCraft：Minecraft智能体能否找到它们看不见的东西？
translated_abstract: 在Minecraft这一常用的具身智能体测试平台中，mineBlock等语义工具直接从模拟器已加载的世界状态中选取目标，而不进行可见性检测，因此智能体从未见过的埋藏矿石只需一次调用即可采到，其得分也无法反映智能体是否真正进行了搜索。我们将这一缺失的要求形式化为“证据闭合”（evidence closure）：智能体系统的每一次决策——包括其工具内部的决策——只能通过智能体持有证据的事实来依赖世界。EviCraft是一个运行时环境与基准测试，它在智能体之下强制执行闭合，并将信息准入规则作为实验变量：感知基础机制（G）只允许视线范围内或由智能体自身行动返回的信息进入，而已加载状态机制（L）则复现标准工具栈，同时保持智能体、工具和世界完全不变。在生存模式下，机制效应超过了最强智能体的领先优势：在G机制下，三个中等规模的智能体以32%-4（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出“证据闭合”概念并构建EviCraft运行时与基准，强制智能体只能依据可见信息或自身行动所得的事实做决策，实验表明仅切换信息准入机制就使中等规模智能体找到钻石的成功率大幅下降，其影响甚至超过不同智能体之间的能力差距。
en_tdlr: EviCraft formalizes and enforces "evidence closure" for Minecraft agents, showing that letting semantic tools exploit the simulator's hidden loaded world state inflates success (e.g., diamond retrieval) far more than differences between agent models.
